case.title: Adapter piece HI: a price increase
case.briefing: Simulator example. You buy part:320050 for Hollerau Pumpenwerke from sup:70270. Need: 6650 pc a year for 1 year(s). The supplier in the simulator is a plain script, not a real bot.

messages.subject: Re: Adapter piece HI: a price increase
messages.body: Simulated supplier. Our quote is attached.

messages.subject: Re: Adapter piece HI: a price increase
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

You have stood by us for years, and we have not forgotten that you held your old price for us in a hard year. That is why we want a solution that is fair for both family companies, not a tug of war over the quote.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you a clear price and a shorter payment term than Option B, and the points below show why we think it is balanced.

On quality:
Your quality was 1531 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70270@2026Q3).

On your current workload:
Obrábění Kraslin s.r.o. puts its turning shop on short-time work (news:20261020-S16).

On the cost side:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 15.91; payment 45 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 16.00; payment 60 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Please take Option A to the owner as a proposal that rewards a long, reliable relationship and keeps both our companies on solid ground.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Thank you for the counter-offer; we read it as a sign that you want this to work as much as we do. Your owner reminded us that he expects partnership in return for the loyalty you showed us, and we take that seriously.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you a clear price and the shorter payment term, which means your money comes in sooner, and it is a fair solution for both family companies.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 16.05; payment 45 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 16.14; payment 60 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Please take Option A to your owner as it stands: it gives your company a firm price and earlier payment from a customer who values what you have done for us and wants to keep working with you for the long term.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
